content.thinking:
I'm working out the document's date, which reads 11/02/2026; the file name and the DN number both point to November 2, 2026. Next I'm sorting out whether the quantity 56.000 means fifty-six thousand or just fifty-six, given the English-language document.

I'm weighing whether 56.000 should read as 56000, since 56 cards at 154 kg would be implausibly heavy while 56000 cards across 11 packages works out to a believable weight per card. I'll go with 56000 and flag the ambiguity. The receiver's handwritten "Meyer K." reads as a signature rather than a correction, so I'll note it in the observations instead.

The 'Received by' signature has no receiving date and no quantity check. There is no receiving stamp.

There are no stamps, strike-throughs or overwrites.

A barcode is printed at the top right.
